summarization:
The smartphone UI screen is titled "Choose prank chat theme" and features six hexagonal icons, each representing a different messaging platform or function. The icons are arranged in a 2x3 grid. The platforms/functions represented by the icons are:

1. WhatsApp (green icon with a white speech bubble and phone symbol)
2. Viber (purple icon with a white phone symbol)
3. Skype (blue icon with a white "S" symbol)
4. Facebook Messenger (blue icon with a white lightning bolt symbol)
5. SMS (orange icon with a white phone and "SMS" text)
6. An additional option (red icon with a white plus symbol)

At the bottom of the screen, there is a banner with advertisements.
